 Apink’s Jung Eun Ji Wraps Four-City Asia Tour, Announces December Encore Concerts in Seoul
 By 
 KIM HA-YOON , Senior Content Writer | Fact-checked by Kim Ha-yoon , Senior Content Writer |

 Apink’s Jung Eun Ji via Instagram 
 Apink’s Jung Eun Ji has successfully completed her four-city solo Asia tour, bringing together fans across the region through a series of performances celebrating her musical journey.
 Following the conclusion of the tour in Taipei on November 14, the singer surprised fans by announcing two additional concerts in Seoul at the end of December.
 Titled ‘2026 JEONG EUN JI SOLO CONCERT [SUMMER, I] ASIA TOUR’, the tour ran for approximately two months, beginning with performances in Seoul on September 12 and 13.
 Jung Eun Ji subsequently travelled to Kuala Lumpur, Hong Kong and Taipei, meeting fans in each destination and presenting music from different stages of her solo career.
 The final performance took place at TICC in Taipei, Taiwan.
 Shortly after the concert, a teaser video announcing the year-end encore shows was unveiled, giving fans another opportunity to experience her live performances before the year concludes.
 Jung Eun Ji Connects With Fans Through Music From Different Eras
 Throughout the tour, Jung Eun Ji showcased her vocal versatility with a setlist combining recent releases, familiar solo tracks and emotional favourites.
 She opened performances with ‘Wave (i love LOVE)’, the title track from her fifth mini album, ‘Summer, I’, before moving on to songs such as ‘Away’ and ‘A Journey to Myself’.
 The concerts also carried special significance as they reflected on the ten years since her solo debut. Jung Eun Ji revisited her first solo release, ‘Hopefully Sky’, and performed it alongside the newer song ‘Following the Wind’.
 The pairing offered audiences an opportunity to appreciate how her musical identity has developed over the years.
 Another nostalgic moment came with the return of ‘Love You I Do’, the song she performed in the introductory video that first presented her as an Apink member.
 Its inclusion brought back memories of her early days in the entertainment industry.
 The setlist also featured tracks from ‘Summer, I’, including ‘NO FIGHT’, ‘Linguine’ and ‘Romantic Party’.
 She further demonstrated her range through performances of ‘Meeting You Among Them’ and ‘For Love’.

 One of the most memorable moments across the tour was the audience participation during ‘All for You’.
 Fans in each city joined Jung Eun Ji in singing the song, creating a shared experience that became a highlight of the concerts.
 The Kuala Lumpur stop was particularly meaningful, marking her first solo concert in Malaysia.
 Apink’s Jung Eun Ji via YouTube 
 She returned to the city approximately five months after Apink’s group concert there in May.
 December Encore Concerts to Continue the ‘Summer, I’ Journey
 Following the Taipei finale, Jung Eun Ji shared her feelings about completing the Asia tour through her agency, Billions.
 “It was far more moving than I expected, and I was happy to meet such passionate and lovely audiences,” she said.

 “Thank you for letting me still feel summer even now, as we move into winter.”
 The singer also expressed appreciation for the fans who supported her throughout the tour, which brought the music of her fifth mini album to international stages.
 Released in August, ‘Summer, I’ features a variety of musical styles and explores emotions associated with different stages of love and relationships.
 Jung Eun Ji participated in producing every track on the album, collaborating with musicians including 10CM, Jukjae and So Soo Bin.
 The project allowed her to explore different sounds while maintaining the emotional storytelling that has become an important part of her solo music.
 The upcoming encore concerts will take place on December 30 and 31 at KBS Arena in Seoul.
 The two performances will extend the tour’s celebrations into the final days of 2026, bringing Jung Eun Ji back to the stage for another meeting with her fans.
 With the successful completion of her four-city Asia tour and the announcement of two additional Seoul performances, Jung Eun Ji is set to close the year with a continuation of her ‘Summer, I’ musical journey.
